dishes.name: Gummy bears
dishes.desc: Haribo Goldbears were invented in Bonn in 1922 and are still made here. Shops in the city sell fresh and fruit-gum varieties.

dishes.name: Grafschafter Goldsaft
dishes.desc: Sweet, dark sugar-beet syrup made in the Grafschaft near Bonn. Spread on bread or stirred into baking.

dishes.name: Rhenish mussels
dishes.desc: Mussels steamed with vegetables and white wine, served with rye bread. A Rhineland pub classic found around Bonn and the river.

dishes.name: Rheinischer Sauerbraten
dishes.desc: Beef marinated for days in vinegar and spices, served with a sweet-sour gravy with raisins and dumplings. A Rhineland Sunday dish.
